title: JEREMIAH 17:7-8
THE MIDDAY WATCH
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: bright midday sun shining through a high study window
quiet wooden desk with a single open journal in daylight
sunlight on a deep river flowing past strong green trees
tall green tree standing firm by a flowing stream under high noon sun
fresh green leaves thriving under bright open daylight
peaceful riverbank under a clear midday sky with tall green trees
gentle river water flowing steadily past tree roots in bright sunlight
calm open field bathed in warm bright midday light

scenes.a: That relentless pressure building in your chest right now demands your attention.
Let us turn our minds to the unchanging promise found in scripture.
Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river,
and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green;
and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
Lord, anchor our lives deeply in your enduring grace during this midday hour.
Grant us steadfast trust when dry seasons surround us.
